answers.answer: 要旨の語数上限は 250 語です。文献引用は含めることはできません。
answers.basis: An abstract of no more than 250 words is required. The abstract must not include references.

answers.answer: 最大 5 つまで書けます。
answers.basis: A list of up to five keywords should be provided below the abstract.

answers.answer: 50 文字以内です。3 ページ目以降の奇数ページから必要です。
answers.basis: At the header on each odd page from page 3, a Running Title not exceeding 50 characters including spaces is required

answers.answer: 句読点（ピリオドやカンマ）の前に角括弧で囲んで記載します。
answers.basis: When cited in the text, reference numbers must be put in brackets in the form [1,3,5-8] before a ‘period’ or a ‘comma’.

answers.answer: 最初の 6 名の著者名を記載し、その後「et al.」とします。
answers.basis: For more than six authors, list the first six authors followed by “et al.”:

answers.answer: 図：TIFF, PNG, JPEG, PDF 形式、300 dpi。グラフィカルアブストラクト：PNG, JPEG, GIF 形式、300 dpi（ファイル形式に GIF が含まれ、PDF が含まれない点が異なります）。
answers.basis: We accept figure files in TIFF, PNG, JPEG or PDF formats . Electronic files of photographs and illustrations should be at 300 dpi resolution... The format of the graphical abstract should be PNG, JPEG or GIF, and the resolution should be 300 dpi.

answers.answer: 1) 本文中の出現順にアラビア数字で連続番号を振る。2) 表題は本文の上、脚注は本文の下に配置する。3) 縦線を使用しない。
answers.basis: Number the tables consecutively with Arabic numerals (for example “Table 3”), in the order of their appearance in the text. Supply a short explanatory title above the body of the table, and table footnotes lettered a, b, c, and so forth, below the body of the table. Do not use vertical lines.

answers.answer: 1 ファイルあたり 20 MB です。超える場合は J-STAGE Data にアップロードし、編集事務局に連絡してください。
answers.basis: The size of each file that is uploaded using the online submission system such as text, tables, figures and supplementary material (if any), should be no more than 20 MB. When the supplementary materials are larger than 20 MB, please upload them to another relating BPPB data repository, J-STAGE Data...

answers.answer: “New”, “Novel”, “First”, “Unprecedented”などの肯定的な形容詞です。
answers.basis: Titles and abstracts of manuscripts may not contain the positive words: “New”, “Novel”, “First”, “Unprecedented”, or other similar descriptive words

answers.answer: 編集判断の受領から 90 日以内です。
answers.basis: Authors who have been requested to revise their manuscript should send the revised version to the handling editor within 90 days of receiving the editorial decision.
